༄༅/ /dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i dka' gnad kyi zhu don dri ma med pa'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i dka' gnad kyi zhu don dri ma med pa'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

gu ru dharmā ā nanda ratna shri bha dra la na mo// gang sngon tshogs gnyis rnam dag las byung zhing*// don gnyis dpal 'byor chen po rab rgyas pa'i// rnam dag sku gnyis mngon gyur srid zhi'i skyabs// rgyal dbang chos kyi rje la spyi bos 'dud// rgya bod lo paṇa mkhas grub du ma yi// gtsug gi rgyan gyur mtshungs med chos kyi rje// de nyid gnyis pa rgyal sras kun dga'i mtshan// mnyam med 'bri gung chos rje la phyag 'tshal// nyid gsungs mdo rgyud man ngag zab gnad rnams// shin tu brling ba rdo rje'i gsung rnams ni// dpag par mi nus rang gzhan grub mtha' las// the tshom dogs gcod skyon bsal zhu ba zhig /'dir mos bdag gis zhu yi bka' bstsal zhu// 'di ltar mnyam med 'bri gung rin chen gyis// phyi rol snang ba rang gi sems su bzhed// byams pa'i dgongs pa ji ltar bzhed pa lags// sems tsam dag dang grub mtha' mthun mi mthun// snang ba'i dngos po ji ltar bzhed tshul ci// sems nyid gnas tshul gang ltar bzhed pa lags// dngos gcig drug tu snang ba ji ltar yin// gcig tu nges bsam gnas med sa bon drug /gcig tu nges na chu min gzhan gyis ci// sa bon 'dod na rtag grub 'gyur mi 'gyur// 'grub gyur bsam pa'i rang gzugs yin na yang*// gshis la sa bon drug tu gnas mi gnas// mi gnas bltas pas 'gyur ba ji ltar lags// mi 'gyur mngon sum longs spyod gshis lags sam// rang gis nyams su len na ji ltar len// grub mtha' gzhan gyis rgol na ji ltar bzlog /gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po de// gzhi nas yon tan mnga' lags sam// mnga' na khams gsum 'khor ba ci// mi mnga' yon tan ji ltar bsgrub// rgyu bsgrubs yon tan gsar 'byung ngam// ma bsgrubs ye ldan ka dag lags// dag na rjes shes e 'ong na// yong na mnyam rjes ji ltar gcig /rjes shes 'khor ba rnam rtog dang*// mnyam gzhag mi rtog chen po gnyis// tha dad 'dod pa mang yod pas// rje yi bzhed pa gang ltar lags// blo 'das yid byed bral ba 'di// lta ba mtha' drug bzhed e lags// chen po gsum gyi ma reg cing*// snga phyi'i rtog pas ma slad pa// blo 'das 'dod pa ha shang yin// zer ba'i rgol ba lung rig sogs// mang pos smad par 'dug pa 'di// yin tshul bsgrub byed bka' bstsal zhu// lta ba'i mthar thug gang la byed// sgom pa skyon med ji lta bu// spyod pa rnam dag ci 'dra bzhed// lta sgom gcig tshul gang la mdzad// bogs 'don tshangs spyod rigs spyod gang*// gzhi lta sgom gtan 'bebs bka' bstsal zhu// lam bslab gsum nyams su ji ltar len// gang zag gcig gi rgyud thog tu// bsrung dus ji ltar bsrung ba dang*// gnas dus ji ltar gnas pa lags// gnad gcig bzhed pa gang la dgongs// gcig tshul ngo bo byed las gang*// bsrung dus gang la gtso cher byed// nang 'gal spong len thug 'dom gang*// 'du shes dngos po gang gtso che// rtsa bzhi dngos po ma gtogs par// 'du shes brten pas e nyams lags// bcas rang gcig tshul ji lta bu// bcas pa gang la ngos 'dzin cing*// rang bzhin gang la dgongs pa lags// rang bzhin sdig dang bcas sdig gnyis// mnyam por 'ong don e yod lags// rang bzhin so skye la'ang 'ong*// bcas sdig rab byung khyad par chos// zhing pa'i dpe sogs bkod pa dang*/

khyad gzhi khyad chos zer bar 'dug /de yi skyon spangs bka' bstsal zhu// sdom pa gnyis pa byang sems la// rten can 'dod dang so skye la// 'jug sdom skye ba ji ltar mthun// byang sems gzhan phan byed pa na// rang gzhan rjes pa nyes byas gsungs// rgyud la dge sems ldan pa la// 'bras bu nag po bskyed lags sam// bskyed na rgyu 'bras go ldog dgos// de phyir gang la dgongs pa lags// smon 'jug sdom dang bslab bya sogs// hril dril nyams su ji ltar len// don dam cho gas skye mi skye// skye na 'dus byas yin dgos 'dra// cho ga 'dus byas yin phyir zer// rje yi dgongs pa cher gsal zhu// sdom pa gsum pa gsang sngags la// sngags dang mtshan nyid khyad gang bzhed// lta ba la khyad par yod dam med// med na rtogs pa mtho don med// yod na ngo bo bzang ngan 'gyur// dbang don rgyud la ma skyes na// cho ga dbang du mi 'gyur zer// cho ga dgos med mi 'gyur ram// dbang don gang la 'jog pa dang*// dpe don ye shes gang la dgongs// bskyed rim sgom lugs yongs grub la// sku dang ye shes gang la 'jog /snod bcud thams cad lha yin na// rang grol 'gyur bar rigs pa lags// lhun grub yin pas 'thad phyir ro// mi gnas nan gyis bsgoms gyur kyang*// lha ru 'gyur ram ji ltar lags// kun brtags bskyed rim sgom tshul dang*// yongs grub gnas tshul ji ltar mchis// dam tshig bsrung dang rdzogs rim sogs// gsang sngags sgom pa ji ltar lags// 'di gsum gong 'og che chung dang*// gnang bkag khyad par ji ltar bsrung*// 'dul bar rtsa bzhi bkag pa dang*// sngags su gnang ba ji ltar gnang*// gcig nyams gsum kar e nyams lags// nyams na bcos thabs ji ltar gnang*// bcos pas gso ru rung mi rung*// ta la'i mgo bcad dper mdzad nas// mi rung gsung ba ji ltar lags// so thar kho nar gsungs pa nas// gsum ka de ltar mi rung ba/

khyad par yod med ji ltar dgongs// gtong thob dus su 'di gsum la// so thar gtong la byang sems ni// shi 'phos dus su mi gtong zer// so thar shi 'phos gtong lags na// bsrungs bas phan yon med pa'i phyir// tha mal pa dang mnyam par 'gyur// des na gtong thob bka' bstsal zhu// spyir rgyal ba'i chos 'khor mtha' yas la// gsum du grangs nges ji ltar gnas// nges don gang la 'jog pa yin// rgya bod lo paṇa mkhas grub rnams// phyi ma gnyis la bzhed gzhung rnams// so sor 'dod lugs mang 'dug cing*// bar pa nges don 'dod rnams kyi// dbu ma 'jug dang rgyud bla rnams// khong du drangs nas mtha' ma ni// nges don 'dod la dgag bzhag yang*// 'bum 'grel tsam du brjod pa dang*// lta ba spros bral kho na las// gzhan rnams log lta yin no zer// mthar thug de las med pa'i phyir// des na bar pa nges don yin// zer ba'i rgol ba gtong bar 'dug /de yi skyon spong bka' bstsal zhu// mnyam med 'bri gung rin chen gyis// tha ma nges don mthar thug tu// bzhed pa'i bka' bstsal mang 'dug cing*// rjod byed chos sku lhun grub 'di// brjod bya stong nyid rgyu 'bras ston// zung 'jug sangs rgyas yon tan can// gzhi 'bras ro gcig yin par bzhed// theg pa sna tshogs ston pa yi// bka' dang bstan bcos mang du yod// lung dang rigs pa mtha' las 'das// tha mar nges pa'i rgyu mtshan yod// lar theg pa gcig tu bzhed pa yin// gsungs pa'i dgongs pa cher gsal zhu// chos 'khor snying po rten 'brel don// zab mo lugs 'byung lugs ldog rnams// rim pa ji ltar bzhed pa dang*// rdzogs dus ji tsam dag tu lags// grub mtha' gzhan gyi bzhed rnams la// tshe dum bu gsum du 'dod pa la// skad cig ma la rdzogs gsungs pa// rdzogs lugs ji ltar bzhed pa dang*// skad cig gsum sogs gang la dgongs// zab mo'i gnad 'gag gang la 'dus// rten 'brel don mkhas rtsa ba gang*// gzhan las khyad par rten 'brel ci// phyi nang gsang ba ji lta bu// zab mo'i gnad kyi bka' bstsal zhu// de ltar gzhi lam skyon bsal nas// 'bras bu skyon med 'thob pa la// sa lam bgrod tshul ji ltar lags// grub mtha'i nang nas bshad pa dang*// rnal 'byor nyams kyi sa lam gnyis// bgrod tshul yon tan e gcig lags// sa dang po'i yon tan med pa la// sa drug nyan rang byang sems gnyis// yon tan mi mnyam ngo bo mnyam// gsungs pa ji ltar dgongs pa lags// sa yi yon tan ji ltar thob// sa dang po gang la ngos 'dzin lags// rnal 'byor chos nyid mthong ba de// chos nyid bden par bzhed lags sam// bzhed na bshad pa'i yon tan med// mi bzhed chos nyid gang la byed// gal te yon tan rting 'ong na// nyi ma sngon song 'od zer rting*// lta bu de 'dra e 'thad lags// mnyam na mthong bar mi 'dug pas// ci yi phyir na sgrub byed yod// ngo bo gcig gi bgrod gsungs pa// tshul lugs ji ltar bgrod pa dang*// 'phel 'grib ji ltar 'ong ba lags// mthar thug sangs rgyas chos sku de// sems can khams la bzhugs gsungs pa// ci lta bu yi tshul du bzhugs// don gnyis 'bras bu ji ltar 'byung*// phrin las rgyun chad yod dam med// 'gro don rtog pa mnga' mi mnga'// ye shes snang ba yod dam med// chos gsung rtog pa e mnga' lags// mnga' na rjes shes min lags sam// mi mnga' lung rtogs bkar mi 'gyur// de yi gnas lugs ci lta bu// sku gsum ngo bo e gcig lags// rnal 'byor pa yi thob bya de// don gyi sku gsum yin lags sam// de rnams so so'i bka' bstsal zhu// hril dril nyams len zhu don ni// rdo rje'i gsung tshig rnams kyi don// zab mo lnga ldan pha yi chos// nyams len rtsa ba ji ltar byed// theg chen byang sems yi dam lha// mos gus phyag chen bsngo ba rnams// ma nor nyams len gegs sel dang*// phyag bzhes dgongs pa 'khrul med kyi// so so'i bka' bstsal mdzad du gsol// zab dang rgya chen gsung dbyangs kyi// the tshom drwa ba gcod mdzad cing*// gnas lugs lam mchog ston mdzad pa'i// gsung don zab mo cher sgrog shog

/mtshungs med chos rje'i legs bshad rta bdun las// lung rig man ngag tsha zer legs 'phros pas// bdag sogs blo gros pad tshal rab rgyas shing*// rkang gnyis bung ba'i don du dri bsung rab rgyas shog / ces pa 'di 'bri gung chos kyi rje rin po che la/ dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i dka' gnad kyi zhu ba/ dri ma med pa'i sgron me zhes bya ba bka' brgyud kyi btsun pa bsod nams ming can gyis zhus pa'o /// /
